title: Atomic subtree admission from a plan snapshot
outcome: One bounded call atomically adds an authored plan of new tasks, dependency edges and supplied parent relationships, returning a local-key-to-work-ref mapping.
acceptance: A plan containing a parent and two levels of children commits all tasks and edges in one IMMEDIATE transaction or makes zero changes.
An identical request retry returns the original result with no duplicate tasks or edges; reusing the same key with different intent explicitly refuses.
One call accepts new tasks and dependency edges using payload-local keys and returns every created key-to-work-ref mapping, without mandatory preview/apply or N add/update calls.
Plan admission does not mirror an external tracker, apply external lifecycle authority or close external tasks.
Whole-input validation rejects duplicate keys, unresolved relationships and cycles with typed refusals; payload and collection limits are explicit and enforced.

completion.summary: Delivered atomic authored local plans with complete key mapping, hierarchy and dependency validation, graph rollback and exact intent-bound recovery. Accepted implementation, regression tests and documentation are committed as 4508181. No external lifecycle, claim, push or installation was performed by plan admission or this closeout.
